title: What does the cube letter C look like from the side and the top?
description: Eight identical cubes are glued into the letter C. The board counts the cubes of the front picture, draws the side view and the top view by looking straight at the letter, and checks that the widths and heights agree with the front.
teaching_notes: One idea: look straight from one side, and cubes hidden behind others add no squares to that view. Watch for students who draw all eight cubes in the side view or the top view.

source: Figure it Out (shadows and views, question 2)
video_script.why: The child reads the side and top views of a cube letter by looking straight at it, and checks them against the front view.
video_script.substitution: Count the cubes from the front picture, then draw one square for every cube seen from the side and from the top.
video_script.anchor: the letter C made of eight identical cubes glued face to face, with frames for its front, side and top views
video_script.payoff_line: The side view is a column of four squares, the top view a row of three

final_answer.value: side view: a column of 4 squares; top view: a row of 3 squares
final_answer.spoken: the side view is a column of four squares, and the top view is a row of three squares

hold_back: Answer: side view, a column of 4 squares; top view, a row of 3 squares
never_show: a side view with eight squares marked as right
maths_rules: front picture of the C: a row of 3 on top, 1 cube on the left in each of the 2 middle rows, a row of 3 at the bottom
the letter is 4 cubes tall, 3 wide and 1 deep
side view: 4 squares in a column
top view: the top row hides all below it, 3 squares in a row
check: front and top views share the width 3; front and side views share the height 4
video_script.design: The cube letter C drawn in the anchor band with three frames. The side and top frames fill in turn, then the front frame lines up against both.
open_questions: The letters asked for in the later parts of the book question are not in the extracted text, so the video solves the first part with the letter C and describes the method for the other parts.
